تصطبحي (form VIII)
# تَصْطَبِحِي (taṣṭabiḥī) /tasˤ.tˤa.bi.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
# تُصْطَبَحِي (tuṣṭabaḥī) /tusˤ.tˤa.ba.ħiː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِصْطَبَحَ (iṣṭabaḥa)
